hop3_viaParamPopulatesTheVariable.how: real browser tab navigated to the operator's own affiliate link https://smartsite.cloud/?via=empressa, then CDP Runtime.evaluate on the loaded page
hop3_viaParamPopulatesTheVariable.THE_FINDING_THAT_DECIDES_THE_SESSION_REA: the value is a VISIT-SCOPED UUID (43ff6ff0-44bf-404f-94aa-e6fdfa2558c5), NOT the affiliate slug 'empressa' that is in the ?via= parameter. So the Stripe session's metadata[promotekit_referral] must equal a UUID, never the string 'empressa'. An operator who opens ?via=empressa and then looks for 'empressa' in the session metadata will wrongly read a correct session as broken; and the UUID is per-visit, so it differs between the operator's browser and this measurement tab.
hop3_viaParamPopulatesTheVariable.howToReadTheExpectedValue: in the SAME browser that will run the checkout: open the affiliate link, read document.cookie for promotekit_referral (or run `window.promotekit_referral` in the console). That exact string is what must appear as metadata[promotekit_referral] on the created session.
hop3_viaParamPopulatesTheVariable.alsoConfirms: the populate half of the pipeline is alive on production: window.promotekit_referral is a non-null STRING, where the invented ?via=p185probe produced null. Same variable, same page; the only variable that changed is whether the affiliate resolves.
hop3_viaParamPopulatesTheVariable.operatorSideConfirmation: PromoteKit's dashboard showed Clicks 0 / Paying Referrals 0 before the operator's first visit; a click should now register there, which is an independent read of the same event from the vendor's side
hop3_viaParamPopulatesTheVariable.carryForward: the referral cookie persists in the browser, so a checkout run in that same browser carries it without needing the ?via= param again

hop4_clientReadsItAtCheckoutTime.shippedRule: readPromotekitReferral() returns undefined for anything that is not a short whitespace-free string, so the live null window value produces NO field on the wire; both POST bodies use `...(x ? {promotekitReferral:x} : {})`, so an undefined reader result OMITS the key rather than sending an empty one
hop4_clientReadsItAtCheckoutTime.falsifierB_status: the null value measured live on production is exactly the input that falsifier (b) names ('a session created without a referral carries the field' = a stale cached value). The shipped rule drops it — and the omit-spread means it cannot be sent as '' either.

cortexDeployMechanismFinding.verdict: MEASURED — and it changes what a canary costs
cortexDeployMechanismFinding.what: deploy-canary (--tag=canary --no-traffic) does NOT shift traffic on this service. Measured before/after at 2026-09-14T14:19Z/14:22Z: the 100% entry kept naming cortex-api-00797-zus and the new revision cortex-api-00799-xaq appeared with tag canary and no percent. Traffic is pinned to a revisionName, not to the tag; the earlier rendering of `tag: canary` on the 100% entry was gcloud resolving the tag for display only.
cortexDeployMechanismFinding.whyItMatters: a canary deploy can be probed at https://canary---cortex-api-tds7av26va-uc.a.run.app WITHOUT a traffic lease; only shift-traffic (--to-tags=canary=100) needs one. This is the cheap order other lanes should use.
